{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Calculate response rates by arm
treatment_response_rate = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_response_rate = df[df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

treatment_effect = treatment_response_rate - control_response_rate

treatment_effect_rounded = round(treatment_effect, 4)

# Print results
print(f'Treatment response rate: {treatment_response_rate}')
print(f'Control response rate: {control_response_rate}')
print(f'Treatment effect (difference in proportions): {treatment_effect_rounded}')"}
